name: $formatCode
description: Returns the formatted code, with function names in their declared case and nested lines indented

args.name: indent
args.description: Spaces per indent level. Defaults to the indent the code uses, otherwise 4

name: $isCodeValid
description: Checks whether the code has no errors, returns bool. Warnings are ignored

name: $lintCode
description: Returns the problems found in the code

args.name: output
args.description: The output format, json by default
